purpose: development-only reference platform qualification; no closure evolution or training
new_resolution_rationale: One factor-two spatial comparison against existing n512 at common dt. Sufficiency is unknown; no automatic further refinement.
reference_source: S_eff = F R_h(w) - R_L(F w), independently verified against -P_L div(F(u*w) - (F u)*(F w))
legacy_source: Original PoF snapshot routine after raw spectral crop, separately saved; never relabelled as S_eff
tail_scope: Both new candidate n1024 references must pass the unchanged raw-vorticity tail limit over the window. Reused n512 tail failures remain visible as coarse-control failures; v1 status is never changed.
convergence_scope: Global-window and maximum-frame relative RMS in low/high/all bands for omega, S_eff and reference_dot; no effect-dependent threshold selection
interpretation: Empirical reference convergence only, not certified continuum error, DNS certification, mechanism validation, model generalization or method approval
distribution_coverage: NOT_ESTABLISHED; reference PASS does not establish applicability of PoF weights
